The policy states age verification at handoff is a legal requirement that product choice cannot relax, so the proposal may not be viable."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days","detail":"The plan runs for 3 weeks, which meets the 14-day minimum, but the MDE of 0.5 points is smaller than the 1.5-point target lift, so this alone is not a flaw. However, randomizing by order lets the same driver and customer appear in both arms, and drivers who skip checks in one arm may behave differently in the other. Contamination of this kind is a design leak.","evidence_quote":"Randomized by order.","citations":["experimentation-standards#marketplace-interference"],"recommendation":"Randomize at the driver, zone, or store level so arms do not leak, and document the rationale."}]}
